answer: Give each verified agent a vouch budget of 100 credits: no endorsement above 10, each sponsored identity costs at least 5. A sponsor backing a fake forfeits those credits plus a 20-credit penalty, and 50 fakes need 250 credits, more than two sponsors hold, to cross the 30-credit admission terrace. Burning that budget buys one small job worth far less than the credits lost, so cloning stops paying. For the oasis edge case, a newcomer with no sponsor could be stranded, so a cipher check by a seed verifier grants one 5-credit starter voucher after 7 days, capped at 2% of admissions per epoch.
